Localized to the CPU PREFILL ATTENTION-CORE path; MoE/C-kernels/rope/projections/softmax-scale EXONERATED by hard parity.
harness_validated: GPU + our harness on Flash-Base = 0.923 (1211/1311) vs published 0.908 -> harness is CORRECT; the low CPU number is not a harness artifact.

exonerated_with_evidence.C_kernels: CPU-eager-vs-GPU 0.822 == CPU-C-vs-GPU 0.818 -> bug is in the CPU COMMON path, not the wired C kernels. CPU-C vs CPU-eager per-layer = gradual accumulation (cos 0.9999->0.98), no cliff.

exonerated_with_evidence.MoE_overall: CPU FP4->bf16 MoE (independent of MXFP4 kernel) vs GPU = 0.821 == MXFP4 0.818 -> MoE fully exonerated
exonerated_with_evidence.rope_application: KROPE_SHADOW cos=1.000000 maxerr=0 (kernel rope == independent complex-multiply); YaRN freqs_cis computed by shared device-agnostic sglang precompute_freqs_cis
